title: IEC 61010-1 / EN 61010-1| Safety Testing Laboratory equipment
description: IEC 61010-1 / EN 61010-1 testing for electrical equipment for laboratories, industrial control. Safety & compliance with ITC India.

sections.heading: Overview
paragraphs: Electrical equipment used for measurement, control and laboratory applications may expose operators to electrical, mechanical, thermal, fire and other hazards if it is not designed and evaluated correctly. IEC 61010-1 establishes general safety requirements intended to reduce these risks throughout normal use and reasonably foreseeable conditions.

ITC India provides IEC 61010-1 testing in India for manufacturers and product developers of electrical test equipment, measuring instruments, industrial control equipment and laboratory equipment. Testing can help identify safety-related non-conformities before certification, export or commercial production.
Manufacturers working across the complete IEC 61010 family can also review ITC India’s broader IEC 61010 Testing Laboratory services.

The exact applicable standard depends on the equipment’s function and construction. IEC 61010-1 provides the general requirements, while additional Part 2 standards can introduce specific requirements for particular product categories.

sections.heading: IEC 61010-1 and Product-Specific Part 2 Standards
paragraphs: IEC 61010-1 is the general standard, but certain products require an applicable Part 2 standard in addition to Part 1.
For example, laboratory equipment used for heating materials may require IEC 61010-2-010 testing. Laboratory refrigerators and similar equipment may require IEC 61010-2-011 testing.
Equipment used for mechanical mixing or stirring can require IEC 61010-2-051 testing, while in-vitro diagnostic equipment may require additional evaluation under IEC 61010-2-101 testing.
Selecting the correct combination of Part 1 and applicable Part 2 requirements before laboratory testing helps reduce unnecessary retesting and compliance delays.

sections.heading: IEC 61010-1 and EMC Requirements
paragraphs: IEC 61010-1 primarily addresses product safety. Electromagnetic compatibility is normally evaluated separately under the applicable IEC 61326 requirements for electrical equipment used for measurement, control and laboratory applications.
Equipment containing electronic controls, digital interfaces, sensors or communication functions may therefore require both safety and EMC assessment.

ITC India provides dedicated IEC 61326 EMC testing for electrical measurement, control and laboratory equipment, allowing manufacturers to plan related safety and EMC evaluations as part of the same overall compliance program.

sections.heading: Why Choose ITC India for IEC 61010-1 Testing?
paragraphs: ITC India supports manufacturers with safety evaluation of laboratory, measuring and control equipment against applicable IEC and EN requirements.

Testing during product development can help identify issues involving electrical insulation, earthing, accessible parts, excessive temperatures, mechanical construction, fire hazards, clearances and protective devices before final product approval.
Manufacturers evaluating laboratory capability can also review ITC India’s NABL accreditation and scope information.
For IEC 61010-1 or EN 61010-1 testing in India, submit your product specifications, technical documents and applicable market requirements through the ITC India testing inquiry form.

sections.heading: What is IEC 61010-1?
paragraphs: IEC 61010-1 specifies general safety requirements for electrical equipment used for measurement, control and laboratory applications.

sections.heading: Which products require IEC 61010-1 testing?
paragraphs: The standard can apply to electrical test and measuring instruments, industrial process-control equipment, laboratory equipment and relevant accessories.

sections.heading: Is IEC 61010-1 enough for all laboratory equipment?
paragraphs: Not always. Some products also require a particular IEC 61010 Part 2 standard covering hazards specific to that equipment.

sections.heading: What is the difference between IEC 61010-1 and IEC 61326?
paragraphs: IEC 61010-1 primarily covers product safety, while the IEC 61326 series addresses electromagnetic compatibility requirements for measurement, control and laboratory electrical equipment.

sections.heading: Is EN 61010-1 related to IEC 61010-1?
paragraphs: Yes. EN 61010-1 is the European adoption of the IEC 61010-1 safety requirements. Manufacturers should confirm the applicable edition and regional requirements for their target market.

sections.heading: Can ITC India test laboratory and measuring equipment?
paragraphs: ITC India provides safety-testing support for laboratory, measurement and control equipment against applicable IEC 61010 requirements. The exact test scope should be determined from the product construction, intended use and applicable particular standard.
